design: INDIVIDUAL 04: an elderly very slender council mediator with a slightly bent attentive stance, warm rust-speckled skin, weathered broad brow, sparse thick grey tendrils just to shoulders. Long plain plum robe with a short square bronze-trimmed cape, many small repair patches and one long vertical ivory panel. Carries a ring of three large archival keys low in one hand while the other raises one clawed finger in measured discussion. Distinct long narrow silhouette.
